description.value: Mactalla Cycles is a full-service bicycle shop on East Hastings staffed by career-minded mechanics with experience across forty years of bicycle technology spanning road, trail, and track. The shop offers comprehensive repairs, setups, and custom bike builds alongside professional bike fittings designed for everyone from daily commuters to competitive cyclists. Their transparent, itemized service estimates and complimentary initial assessments make them a dependable resource for touring cyclists needing mechanical support in Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 85m. Total: 2 spaces.

OSM lists 'community' as 'North Vancouver' but the address (2626 East Hastings, Vancouver, BC V5K 1Z6) is clearly in the City of Vancouver, which is worth flagging.
